title: Offline Research Bench v0: device metrics
description: Speed, memory, sustained-use and offline-proof metrics of ONE system configuration (app build + model + device) on ONE question set. Latency definitions follow MLPerf Client v2.0 (https://mlcommons.org/benchmarks/client/): TTFT = 'the wait time in seconds before the system produces the first token in response to each prompt'; TPS = 'the average rate to produce all of the rest of the tokens in the response, excluding the first one'. Unmeasured values are null and MUST carry a reason in `notes`; never 0.

system.description: What was measured: the app, its build, the model and the runtime.

app.description: e.g. 'BOAR', 'a competitor team', 'a competitor team', or 'BOAR harness (llama-server proxy)'.

build.description: Commit sha / version code of the exact build.

kind.description: 'proxy' = NOT the target phone (e.g. a Mac mini CPU standing in for Android). Proxy numbers are upper bounds for speed and are never ranked against device numbers.

conditions.description: Foreground, airplane mode, charger, ambient temperature, background load (e.g. 1-min loadavg range on a shared host).

n_llm_answers.description: Answers that reached the model. Answers served without the LLM (calculator, snippet, places) are excluded from every latency statistic below.

context_tokens.description: Prompt tokens actually sent to the model per answer (RAG context + system + question). Latency is only comparable at similar context length.

latency.description: MLPerf Client v2.0 definitions. All times in ms, rates in tokens/s.

ttft_model_ms.description: MLPerf TTFT at engine level: prompt submitted to the engine -> first generated token of ANY kind (a reasoning token counts). Excludes model load and retrieval.

ttft_answer_ms.description: Prompt submitted -> first token of the visible ANSWER (reasoning excluded). Equals ttft_model_ms for non-reasoning runs.

ttft_e2e_ms.description: User-perceived: question sent in the app -> first visible answer text. Includes retrieval, routing and prefill; excludes a cold model load unless `includes_model_load` is true.

includes_model_load.description: True if the reported TTFTs include loading the model (a competitor team's ttftS does). Such values are not MLPerf TTFT.

tps.description: MLPerf TPS: (generated tokens - 1) / (time of last token - time of first token), per answer.

tps_engine_reported.description: The engine's own decode rate (e.g. llama.cpp predicted_per_second, app tokPerSec), kept for traceability.

prefill_tps.description: Prompt tokens processed / prompt processing time, per answer.

total_ms.description: Prompt submitted (or question sent, see total_scope) -> last token.

model_load_ms.description: Cold load of the model, once per session.

empty_answers.description: Answers with no visible text (e.g. reasoning used the whole work budget).

peak_rss_bytes.description: Peak resident set, INCLUDING clean mmap'd model pages.

peak_anon_bytes.description: Peak anonymous memory: what the low-memory killer / jetsam counts. macOS: 'peak memory footprint' (/usr/bin/time -l); Android: Private Dirty from dumpsys meminfo (or PSS as an upper bound); iOS: phys_footprint.

peak_pss_bytes.description: Android: TOTAL PSS peak (dumpsys meminfo <pkg>, polled).

valid.description: False if a known artifact inflates it (e.g. llama-server --cache-ram prompt cache left on).

sustained.description: Thermal/throttling after N consecutive questions in one session (bench v0 asks for >= 20).

tps_first5.description: Median TPS of the first 5 LLM answers in session order.

thermal_status_start.description: Android: dumpsys thermalservice 'Thermal Status'; iOS: ProcessInfo.thermalState.

runtime_traffic.description: Kernel per-UID counters during the session (PR #42 scripts/netstats-uid.sh).

per_query.description: Optional per-answer rows (same definitions as above) so a scorer can re-aggregate.

flagged.description: e.g. host load above the gate during this answer.
